name: Phu Quoc pepper
summary: Peppercorns from inland gardens. The nature account calls them aromatic and spicy. The whisper account says a floral aroma and intense heat. The 3-day account says pungent and spicy, and over 1,000 tons a year. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Quoc. Inland gardens. No commune was printed.
taste: Aromatic and spicy on the nature account. A floral aroma and intense heat on the whisper account. Pungent and spicy on the 3-day account. All three stay. That 3-day account says over 1,000 tons a year.
howToEat: Taste it at a garden and take some home. The nature account also says Hàm Ninh’s boiled crab is dipped in muối tiêu chanh.
The whisper account pairs the garden with the morning. A harvest month was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Inland gardens. No commune was printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ho tieu Phu Quoc — island pepper
seoDescription: Hồ tiêu from inland gardens. One account says aromatic and spicy, another floral and hot, and the 3-day account says over 1,000 tons a year.
